title: Artificial Cerebrospinal Fluid VII (ACSF.VII)
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
materials: Calcium Chloride, dihydrate (CaCl2 • 2H2O) (Sigma C3306, C3881 or equivalent)
D-Glucose (C6H12O6; aka Dextrose) (Sigma G7021, G8270 or equivalent)
Magnesium Sulfate, Heptahydrate (MgSO4 • 7H2O) (Sigma M1880 or equivalent)
Sodium Phosphate monobasic monohydrate (NaH2PO4 • H2O) (Sigma S9638 or equivalent)
Potassium Chloride (KCl) (Sigma P9333, P5405, P4504 or equivalent)
Sodium L-Ascorbate (C6H7NaO6 ) (Sigma A7631, A4034 or equivalent)
Sodium Bicarbonate (NaHCO3) (Sigma S5761, S8875, VWR MK739604 or equivalent)
N-Methyl-D-glucamine (C7H17NO5) (Fluka 66930 purchased as Sigma M2004 or equivalent)
P200 pipette tips (Rainin GPL200F or equivalent)
P1000 pipette tips (Rainin GPL1000F or equivalent)
Osmometer sample tubes (Advanced Instruments 3LA825 or equivalent)

steps.title: Prepare reagent stock solutions
steps.instruction: Make all required stock solutions and store them as indicated.

substeps.instruction: 200 mM Calcium Chloride stock: dissolve 29.4 g CaCl₂·2H₂O in 900 mL MilliQ water in a 1 L polystyrene bottle, top up to 1 L with MilliQ water, store at room temperature (RT) ≤60 days.
1 M HEPES stock: dissolve 238.3 g HEPES in 900 mL MilliQ water in a 1 L bottle, top up to 1 L, store RT ≤60 days.
1 M Magnesium Sulfate stock: dissolve 246 g MgSO₄·7H₂O in 900 mL MilliQ water in a 1 L bottle, top up to 1 L, store RT ≤60 days.
500 mM Sodium Pyruvate stock: dissolve 55 g CH₃COCOONa in 900 mL MilliQ water in a 1 L bottle, top up to 1 L, store at 4 °C ≤60 days.
1.6 M Thiourea stock: dissolve 6.08 g thiourea in 40 mL MilliQ water, top up to 50 mL, aliquot 5–7 mL into 15 mL conical tubes, store at –20 °C ≤60 days; warm to RT before use.

steps.title: Label and set up container
steps.instruction: Prepare the primary container for ACSF VII.

substeps.instruction: Label a sterile 1 L polystyrene bottle with reagent name, preparation date, and preparer’s initials.
Place a magnetic stir bar inside the bottle.
Set up a magnetic stir plate inside a fume hood.

steps.title: Determine preparation volume
steps.instruction: Consult the reagent request form to decide whether to prepare 500 mL or 1 L of ACSF VII; the steps below describe the 1 L preparation.

steps.title: Combine initial solution components
steps.instruction: Add water and soluble reagents while stirring.

substeps.instruction: Measure 500 mL MilliQ water with a graduated cylinder and add to the labeled bottle; start stirring at high speed (setting 7 or higher).
Add 20 mL of the 1 M HEPES stock using a sterile serological pipette.
Weigh 186 mg KCl on a calibrated balance and add slowly while stirring.
Weigh 166 mg sodium phosphate monobasic monohydrate and add slowly while stirring.
Add 6 mL of the 500 mM Sodium Pyruvate stock with a sterile serological pipette.
Add 1.25 mL of the 1.6 M Thiourea stock (ensure it is at RT) with a sterile serological pipette.
Weigh 4.51 g D‑Glucose and add slowly while stirring.
Weigh 17.96 g N‑Methyl‑D‑glucamine and add slowly while stirring.
Weigh 990 mg Sodium L‑Ascorbate and add slowly while stirring.
Weigh 2.52 g Sodium Bicarbonate and add slowly while stirring.

steps.title: Adjust pH to 7.3
steps.instruction: Measure and correct the pH of the solution.

substeps.instruction: Using a calibrated pH meter, measure the pH of the stirred solution.
If pH is below 7.3, add 5 N HCl dropwise (up to 16 mL) until pH reaches 7.3.
If pH is above 7.3, add 5 N HCl dropwise as needed (same procedure).

steps.title: Add calcium and magnesium stocks
steps.instruction: Introduce divalent cation stocks after pH adjustment.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.5 mL of the 200 mM Calcium Chloride stock with a sterile serological pipette.
Add 10 mL of the 1 M Magnesium Sulfate stock with a sterile serological pipette.

steps.title: Finalize volume and remove stir bar
steps.instruction: Bring the solution to the final volume and prepare for filtration.

substeps.instruction: Remove the magnetic stir bar using a stir‑bar remover.
Adjust the total volume to exactly 1000 mL with MilliQ water, using the graduation marks on the container or a graduated cylinder.

steps.title: Measure and correct osmolarity
steps.instruction: Verify osmolarity and adjust if outside the target range.

substeps.instruction: Measure osmolarity with the available instrument:
• If using a Freezing‑point Osmometer (Advanced Model 3250), test a 250 µL sample.
• If using a Vapro 5600 Osmometer, test a 10 µL sample.
If osmolarity > 315 mOsm, add MilliQ water dropwise and re‑measure.
If osmolarity < 305 mOsm, add a calculated volume X of 1 mg/mL N‑Methyl‑D‑glucamine (NMDG) solution, where X = volume (mL) needed; re‑measure after addition.
After any osmolarity adjustment, re‑check pH and readjust with 5 N HCl or NMDG as required.

steps.title: Filter the ACSF solution
steps.instruction: Sterile‑filter the final solution through a 0.45 µm filter system.

substeps.instruction: Attach the Corning 1 L 0.45 µm filter system to the Gast vacuum pump using Tygon tubing and turn on the pump.
Filter 500 mL of the solution at a time, keeping the remaining solution on the stir plate.
Collect the filtered ACSF in a sterile 1 L bottle.
Label the filtered bottle with reagent name, preparation date, time, and preparer’s initials.
Record the preparation date, lot numbers of all components, and final osmolarity in the reagent preparation notebook.
Dispose of any excess reagent directly into the municipal sewer system.
Wash the magnetic stir bar with MilliQ water.

steps.title: Storage and usage notes
steps.instruction: Store and use the ACSF as recommended.

substeps.instruction: Prepare ACSF VII within 24 h of human tissue collection.
Store the finished solution at 4 °C until use.
Normally the osmolarity will be within 305‑315 mOsm; only adjust with water or NMDG if needed.

steps.title: Rapid preparation: make 2 M stocks
steps.instruction: Prepare concentrated calcium and magnesium stocks for the rapid method.

substeps.instruction: 2 M Calcium Chloride stock: dissolve 14.7 g CaCl₂·2H₂O in 30 mL MilliQ water, bring volume to 50 mL, transfer to a labeled 250 mL bottle, store RT ≤60 days.
2 M Magnesium Sulfate stock: dissolve 24.65 g MgSO₄·7H₂O in 30 mL MilliQ water, bring volume to 50 mL, transfer to a labeled 250 mL bottle, store RT ≤60 days.

steps.title: Rapid preparation: assemble liquid stock
steps.instruction: Create the liquid component of the rapid ACSF VII.

substeps.instruction: Label a sterile 1 L polystyrene bottle and place a stir bar inside.
Add approximately 500 mL MilliQ water to a 1000 mL beaker, insert the stir bar, and place on a stir plate at medium speed (setting 4‑7).
Weigh 4.77 g HEPES and add to the beaker.
Add 16.5 mL 5 N HCl with a serological pipette.
Add 5 mL of the 2 M Magnesium Sulfate stock.
Add 250 µL of the 2 M Calcium Chloride stock.
Weigh 18.16 g N‑Methyl‑D‑glucamine and add.
Remove the stir bar, then adjust the volume to 950 mL with MilliQ water.
Transfer the liquid to a sterile 1 L bottle; this is the liquid stock.

steps.title: Rapid preparation: prepare solid stock
steps.instruction: Weigh and combine the solid reagents listed in Table 2.

substeps.instruction: Obtain a 50 mL conical tube and place it in a tube holder.
For each reagent listed in Table 2, use a new weigh boat and disposable spatula, weigh the specified amount, and add it to the conical tube.

steps.title: Rapid preparation: filter liquid stock
steps.instruction: Sterile‑filter the liquid stock before mixing with solids.

substeps.instruction: Set aside the conical tube with solids and obtain a 1 L 0.45 µm filter system.
Attach the vacuum pump to the filter system and filter the liquid stock into a fresh 1 L bottle.

steps.title: Rapid preparation: combine and dissolve solids
steps.instruction: Mix solid reagents into the filtered liquid stock until fully dissolved.

substeps.instruction: Label both the solid‑stock tube and the filtered liquid bottle with contents, preparation date, expiration date, and initials; tape the tube to the side of the bottle and store at 4 °C ≤60 days.
Pour the solid‑stock contents into the liquid bottle, secure the cap, and shake vigorously.
Repeat 2‑3 times: add ~40‑45 mL of ACSF VII from the bottle into the conical tube, then back into the bottle, shaking each time, until no powder residue remains.
Add a stir bar to the bottle.

steps.title: Rapid preparation: pH adjustment
steps.instruction: Measure and correct pH of the rapid ACSF VII.

substeps.instruction: While stirring, measure pH with a calibrated pH meter; acceptable range is 7.3‑7.4.
If pH is too high, add 5 N HCl dropwise until pH is within range.
If pH is too low, add small amounts of 1 mg/mL NMDG solution until pH reaches 7.3‑7.4.
Remove the stir bar when pH is acceptable.

steps.title: Rapid preparation: final volume and osmolarity
steps.instruction: Bring solution to final volume and verify osmolarity.

substeps.instruction: Adjust the final volume to exactly 1000 mL with MilliQ water using the container’s graduation marks or a graduated cylinder.
Measure osmolarity with a calibrated freezing‑point osmometer; acceptable range is 305‑315 mOsm.
If osmolarity > 315 mOsm, add MilliQ water dropwise and re‑measure.
If osmolarity < 305 mOsm, add X mL of 1 mg/mL NMDG solution (X = volume needed) and re‑measure.
After any osmolarity correction, verify pH and adjust if necessary.

steps.title: Rapid preparation: final filtration
steps.instruction: Sterile‑filter the completed rapid ACSF VII.

substeps.instruction: Filter the solution through a Corning 1 L 0.45 µm filter system using the vacuum pump.
If the ACSF will be used for slice culture, perform an additional sterile filtration with a 0.22 µm filter.
